fusions.name: Slow Venom Jab
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and makes it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Salvo
fusions.desc: Spits 3 streams in a spread, each dealing 12 damage and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Venomed Bill
fusions.desc: Increases your poison damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanged Calm
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
